This is a '''list of countries by imports''', including both merchandise imports and service imports, based on figures published by the [[Global Trade Union]] for 1765.<ref name="gtu">{{Cite web |url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/trade-outlook/1765/countries |title=International trade statistics by country, 1765 |website=globaltradeunion.org |publisher=[[Global Trade Union]] |date=1765}} Retrieved 1765.</ref> Merchandise imports are goods produced in one country and purchased by another; service imports are services procured across borders between residents of different countries. The figures are in {{lahn}} millions at current prices, and the trade balance is exports of goods and services less imports.
